_meta.purpose: Price-compare shore excursions vs cruise-line + commercial. Agent pays NET, no commission (per Commander 2026-06-13).
_meta.status: PARTIAL — API mapped, but aggressive Imperva bot-wall limits systematic scraping

auth.model: Google SSO login -> sets pe_access (PE user token) + PHPSESSID (session)
auth.note: Product LISTINGS (getLocationProducts) do not require pe_access/login — PHPSESSID + geo cookies suffice. pe_access only needed for booking/account.

api.response_format: <script>var tours = cleanTours([ {product}, ... ])</script> — parse the JS array between cleanTours( and the matching ]

product_fields.productPrice: 'Prices from::US$ ::<amount>::<Per Person|blank>::::1::::USD::' — regex US\$\s*::\s*([0-9.]+); 'Per Person' present = per-person, absent or private_tour set = per-party
product_fields.accessible_tag: 'Limited Mobility Required' (good/low-walk) | 'Wheelchair Accessible' (best) | 'Not Wheelchair Friendly' (walking) | null
product_fields.private_tour: truthy = priced per party (divide by pax for per-person)
product_fields.visitTowns / meeting_location / pickupTo: geography (watch for mis-located tours, e.g. 'from Dubrovnik' under Kotor)

location_id_resolution.redirect_loop_slugs: Athens, Kusadasi, Bari, Nafplion, Bodrum, Katakolon, Koper, Split, Dubrovnik — /location page 301s to itself; defeats curl/curl_cffi EVEN unblocked. Need real browser to resolve id, OR an undiscovered /rq location-search function.

data_quality_filters.noise_keywords_exclude: airport, lounge, audio, self-guided, e-ticket, transfer, atv, quad, jet ski, kayak, hike, diving, scuba, snorkel, bike, cycling, parasail, bungee, skydive, tubing, buggy, segway, jeep, safari, massage, spa
data_quality_filters.senior_fit: skillLevel == Easy AND not noise; prefer accessible_tag good + food/wine + scenic
data_quality_filters.per_person_vs_private: private_tour true -> price is per-party; for a couple divide by 2 (often makes private a per-person bargain)
data_quality_filters.mislocation_check: verify visitTowns/duration match the port — long tours 'from <other city>' get filed under a port but depart elsewhere

antibot_notes.trip_threshold: ~6 requests per IP/session before 403; re-arms fast
antibot_notes.blast_radius: IP-level — blocks the Commander's own browser too, not just the scraper
antibot_notes.curl_cffi_chrome131: DID NOT bypass (unlike Finnair). TLS mimicry insufficient against rate-based Imperva.
antibot_notes.redirect_loop: separate, second blocker on 9 slugs (above) — independent of the wall
antibot_notes.doctrine: On commercial sites with anti-bot: throttle from request #1 (>=3s), cache RAW per-port immediately, cap to priority/decision-grade targets only, abort-on-first-403. Do NOT sweep all targets. Human browsing of the site is fine; only systematic automation trips it.
antibot_notes.recovery: IP-based + temporary. Change egress (hotspot / VPN / Tailscale exit) or wait. Do not repeatedly reload — extends the timer.
antibot_notes.full_sweep_path: would require residential-proxy rotation — judged not worth it 2026-06-13 (8 confirmed ports already decision-grade)

value_finding.headline: Third-party + commercial shore tours beat cruise-line shore excursions ~35-50% at major Med ports, with better structured mobility metadata.
value_finding.loucks_result: Best-value hybrid ~$1,297pp vs ~$2,001pp all-Silversea (~$700pp / ~$1,400 couple saved), before NET pricing + ~$1,520 Silversea shore credit.
value_finding.strategic: Repeatable D2M value-add for EVERY cruise client (Castillo A5 to evaluate as service differentiator). Check PE advisor-commission program (Harlan).
